reviews.text:
A huge thank you to Mr. and Mrs. Clerici, and to Tina, for taking such good care of our little monster, Yoda. Despite his strong personality and terrifying side, you managed to look after him with patience and kindness.

We wholeheartedly recommend Animos! 🐾😻
Very pleasant establishment and friendly staff. I leave my little Bengal cat, Olala, at Animos with complete confidence when I go on holiday. Thank you for everything! 👍 …
A huge thank you to Animos, our cat is always very well received and pampered... I highly recommend them!

I love Animos first and foremost for its wide selection of food and hygiene products. But also for the quality of service provided by Rita and Jean-Louis, the cleanliness, and the kindness and gentleness they show their customers. My cat is now a regular at the hotel; he is always very well received and pampered.
I recommend Animos without hesitation.
See you soon!
I will definitely bring back Tina and Grisou, who had their first stay at your hotel. The staff were competent and friendly.
A very warm welcome, flexibility, love of cats, what more could you ask for?
I 100% recommend this pet shop and cat hotel! The owners are lovely and trustworthy, and the animals are in good hands!

My cat regularly stays at the hotel and it always goes very well!
Jean-Louis, Rita, and Tina are always available and take excellent care of our furry friends!
I recommend it 100% (and so does Touille) 🥰

Frequently traveling, I leave my cat Tasca with complete confidence. The cats are treated with great care.

I highly recommend them.

Lionel

Excellent welcome, very professional and pleasant service. The premises and upkeep are very good.
I leave my cat Pipo at Animos without any worries; the staff are very kind to animals!

Gus and Joy stayed at the cattery for a long time.

We're so happy there that we don't want to go back in the cage when our owner comes to pick us up. The atmosphere is friendly. The owners love cats and are responsible.

Hello

I want to thank the entire Animos team for taking such good care of my little Tigrou 🥰

A fantastic team! It was the first time I left my cat alone with other cats, and he's never been outside in his entire life. I'm so happy he settled in so well and had such a great time.
Thank you, Tina and Rita!

I wanted to thank you for the quality of your establishment, where I have always received excellent advice and a warm welcome.

I knew you had also created a cat hotel some time ago, but hadn't yet had the opportunity to entrust Kenzi to you.

I also wanted to thank you because, as you may have noticed, I had some difficulty getting him back. I imagine you must have taken great care of him, and that he also had the chance to spend time with other cats, not just sleeping alone on the sofa. Upon my arrival, I was delighted to see him playing, something I wasn't used to, as at home he spends his days on the sofa. The other cats seemed to have been very beneficial for him. Thank you again. I will certainly bring him back to you as soon as the need arises, knowing that he will be on vacation until our return.
See you soon.

I highly recommend Animos!

I left my 11-year-old Siamese cat there for 10 days and found him in perfect health and calm. Jean Louis and Rita truly love cats and take wonderful care of them.

I am new to Marseille and living in France. My cat had a great experience staying at their cat hotel for a week. Very caring people which gave me such peace of mind to leave her that long. Recommend highly.

This is the 5th time I've entrusted my two Bengal cats to Animos, and I'm just as delighted as ever.
I have complete confidence in Jean Louis and Rita, who take excellent care of them.
I always pick them up in perfect health and incredibly calm.
I recommend them 200%!

It is with great sadness that I leave this review. I left my cat Una at this cattery twice, and both times there were serious problems.

First time: upon our return, we found Una with her neck completely torn, hairless, and bleeding. I strongly suspect she had been in a fight with other cats. No explanation, no warning from them. Out of kindness (and naivety), we said nothing.

Second time (the last): upon returning from vacation, we found Una exhausted, and most importantly, with enormous feces stuck and festering around her rear end for several days (she's a Persian, with a lot of fur, so it was impossible not to see).
We cleaned it immediately, but her condition worried us. Result: emergency vet visit at 8 pm, diagnosis: infection with the beginning of an abscess.

This is unacceptable. A lack of supervision, hygiene, and care.
THANKS.

The best cat hotel! The owners are passionate cat lovers; for me, my cats go on holiday! The space is large, full of toys and hiding places. It's clean and secure, even has small outdoor kennels and air conditioning. The glass walls make the spaces feel even more open.
Thank you for your professionalism towards my little Sylver. I found my kitten in great shape and awake after being able to play with his cat friends.
Our cat spent about ten days at this boarding facility; the staff were very attentive; we will definitely return; I recommend this place.

It's paradise for cats! Thank you to the whole team for your professionalism and the love you show our cats!

It's truly wonderful and enriching for them.
It's like a holiday for them too, having friends and playing! Thank you, Rita.
A truly excellent cat hotel! My cat Barry goes there frequently, and the staff who take care of the cats are incredibly friendly and professional. I highly recommend this hotel! ❤️❤️👍 …
The facilities are very clean and our little companions are well cared for. I recommend it 100%.
It's very clean here and the owner is very respectful. I recommend it to everyone.
Jean Louis advises and helps us in choosing our products, and his advice has always been the best, excellent store.

A lovely place for our feline friends, who are very well cared for by the attentive owners.
I highly recommend it.
Excellent Crau hay for my guinea pigs, welcoming and friendly staff.
Our cat Ulyss had a wonderful stay, he told us all about it 😁 He made some friends and would gladly come back! A very warm welcome and professional service. We highly recommend Pat&Cat 😻 …
Friendly and personalized welcome. Large selection. Professional advice.

Cat hotel experience:
Impeccably clean.
I would have appreciated some updates with news, photos, etc.
The cats all seem happy 😉 …
Thank you for your beautiful stars.
Thank you for your stars
It's a large store, and I mainly went there for their cat-sitting service. A superb first experience, where my cat also had a wonderful holiday!
The owners were kind and professional. I highly recommend them.
Thank you for your stars.
Excellent service. A wide selection of products at very competitive prices.
Large, well-stocked shop; you'll find everything your dog or cat needs 😀. I've been a customer since 2010! Excellent advice, friendly service, and reliable products! …
